PMSoc’s Biannual Case Competition is back - this time in collaboration with the Project Management Institute !!

Think fast, work together and put your problem-solving skills to the test as you tackle a real-world business challenge and present your recommendations to a panel of industry professionals.

🏆 $500 Prize Pool + Merchandise
🎓 PEP Hours !!
👥 Teams of 3-6
🌏 Open to students from ANY UNIVERSITY - one MUST be enrolled at the University of Sydney
📋 Only one team member needs to register

Registrations Open: Friday, 25th September
Registrations Close: 11:59pm Wednesday, 7th October
Online Briefing (Case Brief Release): 4pm-5pm Friday, 9th October
Preliminary Submissions Close: 11:59pm Friday, 16th October
